description: Search airport transfers on WizTrip (Hotelbeds): private and shared, from an airport (`airport`, IATA) to a hotel (`hotel`, its name) when the flight lands (`arrival`), and back to the airport when the return flight leaves (`departure`, optional). Prices are WizTrip selling prices in USD for the whole vehicle or service (not per person), round trip when `departure` is given. Transfers are not sold alone on wiz-trip.com: they are added when booking a flight, hotel or flight + hotel there.

ages.description: Age of every traveller, e.g. [35, 33, 8]. At least one adult (18+).

airport.description: IATA code of the airport, e.g. "GIG".

arrival.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, local time the flight lands, from today (2026-11-25) on.

departure.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, local time the return flight takes off. Optional.
